cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M
# config small
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":5,"packet_limit":10,"prefix_width":2,"rules":[{"id":1,"class":1,"priority":0,"ranges":[[1,2]]}],"fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":7},"gt":{"class":9}}}
v=M.validate_config(cfg); prog=M.program_from_config(v)

def run(reqs):
    eng=M.Engine(json.loads(json.dumps(prog)))
    outs=[]
    for i,r in enumerate(reqs):
        try: outs.append(eng.handle(r, i==0))
        except M.EventError: outs.append({"error":"event"}); break
    return outs

# boundary idle: open at 0, tick at 5 (T-last=5 == timeout -> no idle)
print("boundary exact:", run([{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},{"op":"tick","time":5}]))
# tick at 6 -> idle
print("boundary over:", run([{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},{"op":"tick","time":6}]))
# id reuse after close
print("reuse:", run([{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},
    {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":1}]},
    {"op":"close","flow":1,"time":1},
    {"op":"open","flow":1,"time":1},
    {"op":"close","flow":1,"time":1}]))
# idle order multiple flows ascending
print("order:", run([{"op":"open","flow":5,"time":0},{"op":"open","flow":2,"time":0},{"op":"open","flow":9,"time":0},{"op":"tick","time":10}]))
# empty flow close W zeros
print("empty close:", run([{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},{"op":"close","flow":1,"time":0}]))
PYEOF
